name: email_read
description: Read the user's emails and summarise them: the latest from a person, what came in yesterday or last week, unread mail, or mail about a topic. Gives the model the email text; reply with a short summary of what it says, what is asked of the user and whether it needs an answer.

sender.description: who it is from as the user said it (Dad, Rohan, a company), or an address

when.description: when it came, in the user's words: yesterday, last week, March, 3 days ago

topic.description: words to search for in the mail, only if the user named a subject

thread.description: true to read the whole recent conversation instead of one mail

examples: summarise the emails about the internship
did the college send anything last week
what's the latest email from Amazon
